TestPersistence::test_persist_simple.description: 1-node cluster, NTS RF=1 keyspace, STCS table, two INSERTs, SELECT *, graceful cluster stop/start (restart_cluster), SELECT * again and assert results equal. No explicit flush, so data reaches sstables via flush-on-shutdown (graceful stop). Added as regression guard for scylladb/scylladb#1581 (sstable write failing on boot due to existing TOC of system.local).

TestPersistence::test_persist_simple.reason: Cheap (~10s, 100% pass) smoke test of write->graceful restart->read; this scenario is implicitly exercised by many restart tests but no scylla test is an exact match (closest test/cluster/test_commitlog.py::test_reboot, dev/debug only). Low unique value; keep only as a gating smoke test. Note: restart_cluster uses arbitrary time.sleep(0.5) (persistence_test.py:23,25).

TestPersistence::test_persist_small_colu.description: 1-node cluster; the driver creates keyspace1.standard1 (blob key, blob c0, RF=1), inserts 5 rows with distinct 1-byte blob values, graceful cluster restart (restart_cluster), then reads each row back and checks the value with assert_one (tools/assertions.py:135, exact list equality). Part of the original persistence suite for scylladb#1581; helper write_and_verify_blobs is parameterized by size but only size=1 is used. Until f38986c045 it used cassandra-stress write/read without comparing values.

TestPersistence::test_persist_small_colu.reason: Redundant with test_persist_simple in the same file: same 1-node write->graceful restart->read-and-compare scenario; blob vs text/int columns and 5 vs 2 rows add nothing (1-byte values not size-specific), and test_persist_simple also has a clustering column. f38986c045 (PR #7562) dropped cassandra-stress and added a value compare, so it is no longer slow or weakly asserted, but the redundancy remains. TestPersistence::test_data_persistence_o.description: Regression for scylla-enterprise#909 (2019.1: map cell with empty-string key lost after flush+compact, visible only after restart since the read came from cache). Creates table with map<text,text>, inserts {'': ts}, reads row (memtable), nodetool flush + compact, restarts the cluster, re-reads and asserts the row equals the pre-restart row (now served from sstable).

TestPersistence::test_data_persistence_o.relevance: Empty map keys still allowed and must persist. The original bug was ka/la-format specific (per enterprise#909 comments: not reproducible on master after mc; issue closed as 'hoping fixed / irrelevant'); scylla can no longer write ka/la (db/config.cc sstable_format allows md/me/ms/mt), so the original code path is gone. Test still guards empty collection key round-trip through current sstable format.

Note: docstring says keyspace 'ks' but code uses 'keyspace1'; last_seen column unused; origin commit 3ba85292 has an unrelated subject.
